body.p: Claims 1-20 will be pending after entry of the present paper. Claims 1, 5, 8, 10, 13, 15, and 19 are amended. Support for the amendments may be found in the originally filed specification, drawings, and claims. Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration of this application in view of the amendments and remarks submitted herein.

p.u: uest for Consideration in the AFCP 2.0 Program

body.p: Applicant requests this application to be considered in the AFCP 2.0 program. Applicant believes this response to be compliant with the requirements of 78 Fed. Reg. 29117. Specifically, Applicant submits form PTO/SB/434 with this reply, Applicant asserts that at least one independent claim is amended that does not broaden the scope, and Applicant is willing and available to participate in any interview initiated by the examiner concerning the amendments and remarks herein.
The Office Action rejects claims 1-5, 9-11, 14-16 and 20 under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being

unpatentable over U.S. Patent Publication No. 2020/0164988 to Alvarez ("Alvarez") in view of U.S. Patent Publication No. 2022/0111087 to Childress ("Childress"). The Office Action rejects claims 6, 7, 12, 17 and 18 under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Alvarez in view of Childress and further in view of U.S. Patent Publication No. 2018/0369434 to Callahan ("Callahan"). The Office Action rejects claims 8, 13 and 19 under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Alvarez in view of Childress and Callahan and further in view of U.S. Patent Publication No. 2008/0131332 to Nguyen ("Nguyen"). Applicant respectfully disagrees; however, Applicant amends independent claims 1, 10, and 15 solely to expedite prosecution.

Claim 1 as amended recites "the health status of the system further includes a surface wear experienced by one or more surfaces of the lavatory in response to the ultraviolet light, the surface wear of the health status is based at least in part on a duration for which the one or more surfaces was exposed to the ultraviolet light and a threshold duration of exposure of ultraviolet light associated with the one or more surfaces" (emphasis added). Applicant asserts that the cited references, either alone or in combination, fail to disclose or contemplate these limitations in combination with each and every element of amended independent claim 1. Applicant amends
independent claims 10 and 15 in a similar manner. Accordingly, Applicant asserts that claims 10 and 15, and their dependents overcome this rejection for similar reasons.

Claims 10 and 15 are amended similar to claim 1 and is therefore patentable for at least the same reasons as discussed above. Claims 2-9 and 11-20 depend from claims 1 and 10, respectively, and are therefore patentable for at least the same reasons as discussed above, further in view of their own respective features. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests that the rejection of claims 1- 20 be reconsidered and withdrawn.

In view of the above remarks and amendments, Applicant respectfully submits that all pending claims are in condition for allowance. The Examiner is invited to telephone the undersigned at the Examiner's convenience, if doing so will further prosecution of the subject application. The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any fees that may be required or credit any overpayment to Deposit Account No. 192814. This statement does NOT authorize charge of the issue fee.
Respectfully submitted, Date: May 31, 2024 By: /Gregg Scheiferstein/
